description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; free trial: add "trial": true or use try_free). [Web and domain checks] IP lookup (IP WHOIS). Who holds a public IPv4/IPv6 address, from the Regional Internet Registry RDAP record: network name, handle, CIDR, address range, country, holding organisation, abuse mailbox, RIR (ARIN/RIPE/APNIC/LACNIC/AFRINIC) and reverse DNS (PTR). No geolocation database and no ASN. Cached 24 h. ~0.5-3 s.

ip.description: Public IPv4 or IPv6 address, e.g. 8.8.8.8 or 2606:4700:4700::1111

trial.description: Optional. true = free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day), else the payment terms.

name: ip_info

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: IP lookup: owner, network and abuse contact of an IP address (RDAP + reverse DNS) ($0.002/call)
